confirmed: The FOB is a navigable encampment used between DMZ deployments and evolves as stations unlock and are upgraded.
The official overview depicts a rugged woodland clearing with autumn foliage, mountain terrain, small military structures, solar panels, a satellite dish and field work areas.
The FOB includes a vehicle shelter and military vehicles, shown in official environmental imagery.
The Firing Range is a wooded grove with targets from close range to more than 100 metres.
The Deploy threshold uses razor wire and leads to a heavy-lift military transport helicopter.
